types.name: AccountCashSnapshot
docs: Version-3 custody payloads are scalar snapshots, never nested account types.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 venue, 1 market, 2 portfolio, 3 margin, 4 deposit, 5 withdrawal,
6 cash transfer, 7 pause, 8 surplus classification, 9 reserve seed, 10 registry.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 withdrawal, 1 transfer, 2 collection, 3 payment, 4 flat netting,
5 retained fees allocated to insurance, 6 retained fee token withdrawal.

types.name: AccountResolutionFrozen
docs: The complete frozen input header; wide derived work is emitted separately.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 1 rejected/reset; 2 exact prescribed clipping; 3 complete verified rates.

types.name: AccountRouteIntent
docs: No historical observation or venue event sequence is signed. Landed relevant
sources, account health, maker epochs and every user limit are checked afresh.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 observe, 1 resolved->custody, 2 explicit candidate reactivation.

fields.name: markets
docs: Canonical index 0 BTC, 1 ETH; immutable after both registrations.

fields.name: mode
docs: 0 custody, 1 isolated trading, 2 cross trading, 3 frozen resolution.

types.name: CurveControl
docs: Borsh discriminants 0..3, with no extra vector-length prefix on the payload.

fields.name: sequence
docs: Event discovery order only; never an ordinary signed-intent prerequisite.

fields.name: liability_versions
docs: Only market-dependent economic mutations invalidate gain certificates.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 initialize, 1 register, 2 deposit, 3 withdraw, 4 insurance, 5 surplus, 6 pause.

fields.name: participant
docs: Default pubkey means a market-wide event.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 group, 1 market, 2 portfolio, 3 margin, 4 deposit, 5 withdraw,
6 internal transfer, 7 unfrozen pause, 8 unsolicited surplus to insurance, 9 explicit fee allocation.

fields.name: actual_vault
docs: None when this operation does not read the token account.

types.name: GroupMemberCashV2
docs: V2 custody events are separate from V1's market-scoped journal.

fields.name: claim_scaled
docs: Both fully valued claims net once, inside this margin account only.

fields.name: root_states
docs: At most three roots; keys derive from each immutable portfolio/child identity.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 activate, 1 collect, 2 pay, 3 deposit, 4 withdraw, 5 transfer.

fields.name: approved_hash
docs: Entire loader ProgramData, including deployment slot, authority and code.

fields.name: claim
docs: Valued claim plus collected*SCALE. Ordinary v remains frozen until Apply.

types.name: LiquidityRegistryPayload
docs: Event payload: identical field bytes without an account discriminator.

types.name: LiquidityRouteLeg
docs: D70 signs structural authority, never a price sequence or consumption prefix.

fields.name: mode
docs: 0 disabled, 1 enabled, 3 enabled and maker-inventory reduce-only.

types.name: MakerRegistrationPayload
docs: Event payload: identical field bytes without an account discriminator.

fields.name: positions
docs: Canonical venue-registry indices, not a user-selected group membership.

fields.name: book
docs: Reuse only the stable scalar wire records; V2 handlers cannot own V3 bytes.

fields.name: positions
docs: Index equals the immutable group's market index, even for empty entries.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Diagnostic cache only; admission recomputes the complete order book.

fields.name: insurance_fee_remainder
docs: Modulo-four fee-count carry, never collateral or a participant claim.

fields.name: mode
docs: 0 CustodyOnly, 1 synthetic TestRoutes, 2 oracle profile, 3 frozen resolution.

fields.name: allocated_vault
docs: Allocated token assets. Actual vault may have separately observable surplus.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 no credible bounds, 1 degraded, 2 normal (subject to live clock checks).

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 place, 1 replace, 2 cancel, 3 protective pair, 4 cancel group, 5 cleanup.

fields.name: trigger
docs: 0 none, 1 central reference >= threshold, 2 <= threshold.

fields.name: order_ids
docs: Zero means inactive; IDs never repeat when a bounded slot is reused.

fields.name: children
docs: Nine immutable child identities; there is no account deletion/reuse.

fields.name: rate_factor
docs: At most 186 bits; unused high six bits must be zero.

fields.name: finalized
docs: Apply invalidates all active orders, zeros reserves/IDs and group allowance.
Collection leaves the full existing book and nonce unchanged.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 freeze/reset rows, 1 page, 2 valuation/recovery check, 3 resume.

types.name: ResolutionRow
docs: Fixed scalar inputs are enough to reconstruct every terminal exact adjustment.

fields.name: exact_flow_numerators
docs: Magnitudes. Direction is determined by the original claim sign.

types.name: ResolutionWork
docs: Bounded continuation registers for arithmetic, proof scans and circulation.
P26 verifies every opcode/cursor; caller data is not a trusted payout plan.

fields.name: residual_capacity
docs: Original <=192 edges plus <=67 residual source/sink edges, both directions.

fields.name: market_edge_order
docs: Market forward-edge ordering is checked as a complete stable permutation.

types.name: RetirementCertificate
docs: Terminal administrative proof only. Ordinary owner exits never depend on
this complete-cohort scan or its global discovery-sequence stamp.

fields.name: all_in_limit
docs: Buy: maximum gross+fee. Sell: minimum gross-fee.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 collect loss, 1 settle gain, 2 withdraw funded cash.

fields.name: delegate_epoch
docs: Zero for owner-created authority, otherwise the root's delegate epoch.

types.name: Wide
docs: Unsigned little-endian fixed width. Zero has exactly the all-zero encoding.
Work arithmetic is checked; no integer truncation or floating point.
